content:
**VATS Matrix Overlay** is a Power Armor mod in *Fallout 76*.

The mod can be attached to a range of Power Armor Helmets, it increases the hit chance in V.A.T.S. by 10%. This effect stacks with the 50% bonus from weapons that have the V.A.T.S. Enhanced Legendary Mod.

To craft the VATS Matrix Overlay, a Power Armor Chassis with the desired helmet piece attached must be installed at a Power Armor Stations.
